questions.markdown: A coil of resistance $50\ \Omega$ and inductance $0.318\ \mathrm{H}$ is connected in parallel with a circuit comprising a $75\ \Omega$ resistor in series with a $159\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor. Assuming $V_{AB}$ as reference voltage, determine line currents, total power consumed and current in the neutral of the system.
